Pitru Paksha 2026 Concludes with Sarva Pitru Amavasya

The Pitru Paksha period of 2026 is concluding with Sarva Pitru Amavasya on October 10. This day is observed to offer prayers and perform rituals for ancestors. According to tradition, donating certain items on this day is believed to bring blessings from ancestors.
